text:
taylor: @channel customer escalated — hosted inference us-west-2 seeing ~30% 5xx and client timeouts since ~2026-03-16T11:28Z. Customers report 502/504 from API gateway. Opening triage.

hailey: on it — can someone paste recent gateway/error logs? I'll check traces.

samir: looking at runtime metrics: p50 latency jumped from 120ms to 900ms, p95 > 5s. Batcher queue depth spiked. Heap/CPU on a few inference nodes hit 85-95% around 11:26.

ben: infra shows sudden connection resets from auth-proxy -> inference-proxy. Logs:
```
2026-03-16T11:27:41Z error: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream
2026-03-16T11:27:41Z warn: keepalive_timeout 10s reached, terminating
```

taylor: support says customers see `504 Gateway Timeout` on long generation calls and `502` on short ones. Billing/auth checks looked normal.

ops-bot: automated action: routed 10% traffic to eu fallback region at 11:38 UTC. Logged as action id: route-20260316-1138

hailey: mitigations to try now: 1) increase gateway timeout to 45s 2) enable fallback to quantized model variant 3) bump inference node ASG desired by +20% to drain backlog. Agree?

samir: +1. Also suggest temporarily disabling strict authz RTT enforcement (our short TTL for auth cache) — that was spiking cache miss rate.

taylor: applying 1 & 3 now. Samir, can you toggle auth cache TTL to 60s? I'll coordinate with infra for scale.

samir: done — auth cache TTL -> 60s (PR: infra/auth-cache#452). Auth cache miss rate dropping from 28% -> 4%.

ben: ASG scaled up by +24% at 11:42 UTC; pods coming up, but two old nodes show `OOMKilled` in the last hour. Investigating image/oom changes.

taylor: Support repro steps for customer engineers:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generation -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd/long-2.7b","input":"<long prompt>"}' -v
2) add header `X-Debug-Trace: 1` to capture gateway-id and span
3) if you see `504` include gateway-id and sample request-id

hailey: quick check results: 11:50 UTC error rate down to 6%, p95 back to ~600ms. Will open postmortem and action items.

taylor: action items:
- hailey: write postmortem draft (due 2026-03-18) [OWNER]
- samir: investigate auth-cache regression root cause and revert to more robust backoff (due 2026-03-17)
- ben: node image and OOMs correlation, look at memory pressure and GC tuning (due 2026-03-17)
- infra: implement circuit-breaker on gateway -> inference with backoff and faster fallback (due 2026-04-01)

eva: product note — notify customers affected with a short timeline and mitigation summary; coordinate with comms.

support-bot: created ticket INC-2026-4532 for customer outreach and attachments requested.

hailey: postmortem link will be posted here when ready. Thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:
